# cDot

> cDot is the network for verified identity, encrypted communication, instant payments, and
> programmable money - the internet as it should have been. Built by Certonymity Ltd (London, UK).

cDot is built on the C-Layer, a blockchain for secure, decentralised identity run by independent
nodes worldwide. Coming soon is the full family of three purpose-built blockchains, each engineered
for what it does best: decentralised identity, stablecoin settlement, and trading, operating as one
trusted network.

Mission: cDot is secure, private, and scalable. It is the blockchain network built for secure,
private, and instant interactions between verified parties - whether in the form of email,
messaging, payments, or trades. Using cryptographic pseudonyms of real verified identities, cDot
ensures every communication or transaction is both private and accountable.

The problem: cDot is where value is exchanged between people, businesses, and machines. Stablecoins
enable instant, borderless, programmable transactions - but today's blockchains aren't designed for
them. Existing systems are either fully general or optimised for trading, and none were built to
integrate identity with payments. Transactions at scale don't just need speed and low cost. They
need verifiable identity on both sides, including a system for identity that can account for the AI
agents increasingly transacting on behalf of people and businesses. With decentralised identity,
stablecoin payments, and agent permissions, cDot exists to close the gap. cDot is built by the team
behind c.Email (https://c.email/).

The network (three chains, interoperable by design):

1. C-Layer - identity and asset recovery chain: a decentralised identity chain for people,
   businesses, and agents. Cryptographic pseudonyms of verified real identities provide privacy with
   accountability. 15,000 tx/s through a highly parallel architecture, WASM smart contracts, 20s
   finality, permissionless, public and pseudonymous, run by nodes around the world for maximum
   resilience and decentralisation.
2. P-Layer - settlement chain: engineered for high-throughput, low-cost global stablecoin
   settlement and truly programmable money, with native on- and off-ramping; 30,000 tx/s, finality
   <1s, byzantine security 45%; agentic transactions supported with verifiable, revocable
   permissions.
3. T-Layer - trading chain: a high-performance decentralised exchange, offering stablecoin swaps and
   perpetual futures in a predictable execution environment. 30,000 tx/s through native
   multithreaded operations, finality <1s, a node-permissioned overlay on the C-Layer, private and
   accountable, native NASDAQ-like matching engine.

Use cases - encrypted email and messaging, anonymous age verification, verifiable credentials,
global payments, embedded finance, microtransactions, agentic payments, asset recovery (never lose
your self custodied crypto). Secure design and invisible cryptography means every transaction
settles instantly, every participant (human or agent) is verified and accountable, while every
real-world identity and transaction stays private.
